Release

  • CURIE: gmeow:Release
  • IRI: https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/Release
  • Category: class
  • Defined by: gmeow:slices/software

A software release — an event that produces a versioned software product, typically associated with a tag, a DOI, and one or more distribution artifacts. The event facet of the five-facet model; a release is an occurrence, not the product itself.

Structure

Subclass of: gmeow:Event

Practical Pattern

Use gmeow:Release as a specialized kind of gmeow:Event. Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.
